name: WIlla Cassandra Riggins(abyssknight)
biography: is a penetration tester at Veracode, and was previously part of the Lockheed Martin CIS Red Team. She started her career as a developer and pivoted into security to help fight the pandemic that is developer apathy. Her background spans the software development lifecycle, but her heart is in root shells and crown jewels. She can be found making things at FamiLAB in Orlando, hacking at the local DC407 meet-ups, staffing the socials at BSides Orlando, and marketing all the things at OWASP Orlando. Twitter: @willasaywhat
